description.p: Typecase is a quiet writing app for Markdown. Your texts live in a library of groups and sheets, stored as plain .md files in a folder of your choice — no database, no account, no network access.

ul.li: Markdown styled as you type, with a formatting bar for those who don't want to learn the syntax
Focus mode with typewriter scrolling and dimmed surroundings
Group view: read and edit all sheets of a chapter or book as one continuous text
Card view for plotting: the notes of all sheets as cards, reordered by dragging
Writing goals with progress rings, keywords, notes and attachments per sheet
Spell checking while you type, offline and in each sheet's language
Editor themes in light and dark, and your own GtkSourceView themes
Export single sheets or whole groups to PDF, Word and HTML with importable templates

description.p: Typecase works completely offline and collects no data.
